albedo.title: Cassini 可见光橙色不透明雾霾外观重建 / PIA06227
albedo.observationEpoch: Cassini ISS 2005-04-16 comparison; not real-time weather
albedo.rights: NASA media guidelines; acknowledge NASA/JPL/Space Science Institute. No image pixels used as a planetary map.
albedo.colorProcessing: 依照自然色观测重建橙色不透明雾霾与弱蓝色边缘；颜色、透明度和厚度显示参数不是反演测量。没有地表光学贴图。
albedo.projection: No surface or cloud texture; spherically symmetric display reconstruction

geometrySource.title: Independent haze layers; scientific surface radius retained

atmosphere.notes: 500 km detached haze was observed in the Cassini era; layer shape/opacity here are a static display reconstruction, not a current atmosphere model

reconstructionNotes: 可见光默认只显示不透明大气，地表不可见。橙色雾霾和弱蓝色边缘是依据 Cassini 观测的显示重建；没有借用近红外地表图冒充自然色。
visualEnhancements: 雾霾的颜色、层厚和透明度为显示重建；不是实时大气参数
limitations: 不含实时极涡、云图或气候演化
不模拟多次散射或完整辐射传输
200 km 不透明代理层及外层透明度为静态展示选择
没有地表光学地图，因此不声明地表参考经线配准
